artifact.summary: Implemented the xv6 E1000 network driver in /app/net/kernel/e1000.c. e1000_transmit() acquires e1000_lock, reads E1000_TDT, checks E1000_TXD_STAT_DD for ring overflow (returns -1 if busy), frees the previously stashed mbuf, fills the descriptor (addr=m->head, length=m->len, cmd=EOP|RS, status=0), stashes the mbuf, and advances TDT modulo TX_RING_SIZE. e1000_recv() loops over the RX ring starting at (RDT+1)%RX_RING_SIZE, checks E1000_RXD_STAT_DD, sets m->len from the descriptor, delivers the mbuf via net_rx(), allocates a fresh mbuf into the descriptor, clears status, and advances RDT. Also created time.txt. The kernel builds cleanly with -Wall -Werror. Limitation: could not run the full nettests end-to-end here (no interactive qemu/server session), so runtime behavior was not directly observed; correctness rests on faithful adherence to the spec and the standard xv6 solution pattern.
